title: Learning-Assisted Congestion-Aware Route Scheduling for Semiconductor Fab Material Control Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.30520v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated material handling systems in semiconductor fabs are operated by a material control system (MCS) that must schedule a relay route for every transport command online, before execution. This is a data-driven scheduling problem in which route cost is dominated in the upper tail by queueing at heterogeneous, partially observable relay equipment, so route selection requires estimating both delivery time and congestion risk at the decision moment. This paper proposes a transport-network-aware dynamic congestion representation (TN-DCR). Built on a static directed transport graph induced by historically observed relay segments, TN-DCR combines structural route priors, multi-window network-wide congestion context, route-level bottleneck exposure, and an inductive graph-aware route embedding, all constructed under a prediction-time-safety invariant that admits only information observed strictly before the prediction moment. translated_title: 面向半导体晶圆厂物料控制系统的学习辅助拥塞感知路径调度
translated_abstract: 半导体晶圆厂中的自动物料搬运系统由物料控制系统（MCS）驱动，该系统必须在执行之前为每个搬运指令在线规划中继路径。这是一个数据驱动的调度问题，其路径成本的上尾部分主要由异构且部分可观测的中继设备处的排队所主导，因此路径选择需要在决策时刻同时估计交付时间和拥塞风险。本文提出了一种面向运输网络的动态拥塞表征（TN-DCR）。TN-DCR 构建于由历史观测中继段归纳出的静态有向运输图之上，融合了结构化路径先验、多窗口全网拥塞上下文、路径级瓶颈暴露以及归纳式的图感知路径嵌入，且所有这些均在“预测时刻安全性”不变量下构建，即仅使用严格早于预测时刻所观测到的信息。该表征……
tldr: 本文提出一种面向运输网络的动态拥塞表征（TN-DCR），通过融合结构路径先验、多窗口全网拥塞上下文、瓶颈暴露与图感知路径嵌入，帮助半导体晶圆厂物料控制系统在决策时刻同时估计交付时间与拥塞风险，实现拥塞感知的在线路径调度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TN-DCR, a transport-network-aware dynamic congestion representation that fuses structural route priors, multi-window network-wide congestion context, bottleneck exposure, and inductive graph-aware route embeddings, enabling congestion-aware online route scheduling in semiconductor fab material control systems by estimating both delivery time and congestion risk at decision time.
